</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c042035-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9905"><ns0:num value="9905">§ 9905.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Distribution to territories</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042036-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9905/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Apportionment</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary shall apportion the amount reserved under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b/1">section 9903(b)(1) of this title</ns0:ref> for each fiscal year on the basis of need among Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042037-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9905/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Application</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Each jurisdiction to which subsection (a) applies may receive a grant under this section for the amount apportioned under subsection (a) on submitting to the Secretary, and obtaining approval of, an application, containing provisions that describe the programs for which assistance is sought under this section, that is prepared in accordance with, and contains the information described in, <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908">section 9908 of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c042038-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s675A">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 675A</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2730">112 Stat. 2730</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c042039-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="editorialNotes" id="id9c04203a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Editorial Notes</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="priorProvisions" id="id9c04203b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Prior Provisions</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Prior sections 9905 and 9905a were omitted in the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. L. 105–285</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
<ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Section 9905, <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s676">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 676</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1981-08-13">Aug. 13, 1981</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/95/516">95 Stat. 516</ns0:ref>, related to establishment and functions of the Office of Community Services.</ns0:p>
<ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Section 9905a, <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s676A">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 676A</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/98/558/tII/s203/d">Pub. L. 98–558, title II, § 203(d)</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1984-10-30">Oct. 30, 1984</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/98/2885">98 Stat. 2885</ns0:ref>; amended <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/99/425/tIV/s403/a/2">Pub. L. 99–425, title IV, § 403(a)(2)</ns0:ref>–(4), <ns0:date date="1986-09-30">Sept. 30, 1986</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/100/968">100 Stat. 968</ns0:ref>, 969; <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/101/501/tIV/s404/c">Pub. L. 101–501, title IV, § 404(c)</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1990-11-03">Nov. 3, 1990</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/104/1252">104 Stat. 1252</ns0:ref>, related to procedures for review of termination or reduction of funding.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c04203c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906"><ns0:num value="9906">§ 9906.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Allotments and payments to States</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04203d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Allotments in general</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary shall, from the amount appropriated under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/a">section 9903(a) of this title</ns0:ref> for each fiscal year that remains after the Secretary makes the reservations required in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b">section 9903(b) of this title</ns0:ref>, allot to each State (subject to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9911">section 9911 of this title</ns0:ref>) an amount that bears the same ratio to such remaining amount as the amount received by the State for fiscal year 1981 under section 2808 <ns0:ref class="footnoteRef" idref="fn003923">1</ns0:ref><ns0:note type="footnote" id="fn003923"><ns0:num>1</ns0:num> See References in Text note below.</ns0:note> of this title bore to the total amount received by all States for fiscal year 1981 under such section, except—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c04203e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/a/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> that no State shall receive less than ¼ of 1 percent of the amount appropriated under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/a">section 9903(a) of this title</ns0:ref> for such fiscal year; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c04203f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/a/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> as provided in subsection (b).</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042040-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Allotments in years with greater available funds</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042041-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/b/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Minimum allotments</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3), if the amount appropriated under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/a">section 9903(a) of this title</ns0:ref> for a fiscal year that remains after the Secretary makes the reservations required in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b">section 9903(b) of this title</ns0:ref> exceeds $345,000,000, the Secretary shall allot to each State not less than ½ of 1 percent of the amount appropriated under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/a">section 9903(a) of this title</ns0:ref> for such fiscal year.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042042-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/b/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Maintenance of fiscal year 1990 levels</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Paragraph (1) shall not apply with respect to a fiscal year if the amount allotted under subsection (a) to any State for that year is less than the amount allotted under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/a/1">section 9903(a)(1) of this title</ns0:ref> (as in effect on <ns0:date date="1989-09-30">September 30, 1989</ns0:date>) to such State for fiscal year 1990.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042043-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/b/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Maximum allotments</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The amount allotted under paragraph (1) to a State for a fiscal year shall be reduced, if necessary, so that the aggregate amount allotted to such State under such paragraph and subsection (a) does not exceed 140 percent of the aggregate amount allotted to such State under the corresponding provisions of this chapter for the preceding fiscal year.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042044-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Payments</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary shall make grants to eligible States for the allotments described in subsections (a) and (b). The Secretary shall make payments for the grants in accordance with <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t31/s6503/a">section 6503(a) of title 31</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042045-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9906/d"><ns0:num value="d" class="bold">(d)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Definition</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">In this section, the term “State” does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c042046-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s675B">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 675B</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2730">112 Stat. 2730</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c042047-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="editorialNotes" id="id9c042048-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Editorial Notes</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I75" topic="referencesInText" id="id9c042049-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">References in Text</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s2808">Section 2808 of this title</ns0:ref>, referred to in subsec. (a), was repealed by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s683/a">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 683(a)</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1981-08-13">Aug. 13, 1981</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/95/519">95 Stat. 519</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="priorProvisions" id="id9c04204a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Prior Provisions</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">A prior section 9906, <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s677">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 677</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1981-08-13">Aug. 13, 1981</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/95/516">95 Stat. 516</ns0:ref>, contained nondiscrimination provisions, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. L. 105–285</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c04204b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907"><ns0:num value="9907">§ 9907.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Uses of funds</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04204c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Grants to eligible entities and other organizations</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04204d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to a State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall be used by the State to make grants for the purposes described in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9901">section 9901 of this title</ns0:ref> to eligible entities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04204e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Obligational authority</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04204f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Recapture and redistribution of unobligated funds</ns0:heading><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042050-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a/3/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Amount</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">Beginning on <ns0:date date="2000-10-01">October 1, 2000</ns0:date>, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042051-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a/3/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Redistribution</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042052-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Statewide activities</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042053-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Use of remainder</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042054-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> providing training and technical assistance to those entities in need of such training and assistance;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042055-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> coordinating State-operated programs and services, and at the option of the State, locally-operated programs and services, targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other organizations funded under this chapter, including detailing appropriate employees of State or local agencies to entities funded under this chapter, to ensure increased access to services provided by such State or local agencies;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042056-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042057-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/D"><ns0:num value="D">(D)</ns0:num><ns0:content> analyzing the distribution of funds made available under this chapter within the State to determine if such funds have been targeted to the areas of greatest need;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042058-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/E"><ns0:num value="E">(E)</ns0:num><ns0:content> supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals, such as programs supporting individual development accounts;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042059-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/F"><ns0:num value="F">(F)</ns0:num><ns0:content> supporting innovative programs and activities conducted by community action agencies or other neighborhood-based organizations to eliminate poverty, promote self-sufficiency, and promote community revitalization;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c04205a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/G"><ns0:num value="G">(G)</ns0:num><ns0:content> supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c04205b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/1/H"><ns0:num value="H">(H)</ns0:num><ns0:content> supporting other activities, consistent with the purposes of this chapter.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04205c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Administrative cap</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9905">section 9905 of this title</ns0:ref> or State allotment received under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9906">section 9906 of this title</ns0:ref> for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities. Funds to be spent for such expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9905">section 9905 of this title</ns0:ref> or State allotment that remains after the State makes grants to eligible entities under subsection (a). The cost of activities conducted under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered to be administrative expenses. The startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered to be administrative expenses.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04205d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Charity tax credit</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04205e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04205f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Limit</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before <ns0:date date="1999-01-01">January 1, 1999</ns0:date>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042060-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Definitions and rules</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">In this subsection:</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042061-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Charity tax credit</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">The term “charity tax credit” means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042062-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Qualified charity</ns0:heading><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042063-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i"><ns0:num value="i" class="bold">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">The term “qualified charity” means any organization—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c042064-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i/I"><ns0:num value="I">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> that is—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042065-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i/I/aa"><ns0:num value="aa">(aa)</ns0:num><ns0:content> described in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t26/s501/c/3">section 501(c)(3) of title 26</ns0:ref> and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title;</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042066-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i/I/bb"><ns0:num value="bb">(bb)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an eligible entity; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042067-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i/I/cc"><ns0:num value="cc">(cc)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a public housing agency as defined in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1437a/b/6">section 1437a(b)(6) of this title</ns0:ref>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c042068-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i/II"><ns0:num value="II">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:content> that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c042069-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/i/III"><ns0:num value="III">(III)</ns0:num><ns0:content> if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of such title, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04206a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/ii"><ns0:num value="ii" class="bold">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Certain contributions to collection organizations treated as contributions to qualified charity</ns0:heading><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04206b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/ii/I"><ns0:num value="I" class="bold">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04206c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/ii/II"><ns0:num value="II" class="bold">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Collection organization</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">The term “collection organization” means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of such title and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c04206d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/ii/II/aa"><ns0:num value="aa">(aa)</ns0:num><ns0:content> that solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities;</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c04206e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/ii/II/bb"><ns0:num value="bb">(bb)</ns0:num><ns0:content> that distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c04206f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/ii/II/cc"><ns0:num value="cc">(cc)</ns0:num><ns0:content> that meets the requirements of clause (vi).</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042070-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iii"><ns0:num value="iii" class="bold">(iii)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Charity must primarily assist poor individuals</ns0:heading><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042071-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iii/I"><ns0:num value="I" class="bold">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">An organization meets the requirements of this clause only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042072-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iii/II"><ns0:num value="II" class="bold">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> No recordkeeping in certain cases</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042073-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iii/III"><ns0:num value="III" class="bold">(III)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Food aid and homeless shelters</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042074-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iii/III/aa"><ns0:num value="aa">(aa)</ns0:num><ns0:content> donations of food or meals; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042075-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iii/III/bb"><ns0:num value="bb">(bb)</ns0:num><ns0:content> temporary shelter to homeless individuals;</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
</ns0:subclause>

<ns0:continuation style="-uslm-lc:I56" class="indent4 firstIndent-2">  shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).</ns0:continuation>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042076-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iv"><ns0:num value="iv" class="bold">(iv)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Minimum expense requirement</ns0:heading><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042077-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iv/I"><ns0:num value="I" class="bold">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">An organization meets the requirements of this clause only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I72" class="indent6 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042078-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iv/II"><ns0:num value="II" class="bold">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Poverty program expense</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4">For purposes of subclause (I)—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580469" class="indent7 firstIndent-2 bold" id="id9c042079-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iv/II/aa"><ns0:num value="aa">(aa)</ns0:num><ns0:heading> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5">The term “poverty program expense” means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580469" class="indent7 firstIndent-2 bold" id="id9c04207a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/iv/II/bb"><ns0:num value="bb">(bb)</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Exceptions</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5">Such term shall not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t26/s4911/d">section 4911(d) of title 26</ns0:ref>), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04207b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/v"><ns0:num value="v" class="bold">(v)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Reporting requirement</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">The information required to be furnished under this clause about an organization is—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c04207c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/v/I"><ns0:num value="I">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the percentages determined by dividing the following categories of the organization’s expenses for the year by the total expenses of the organization for the year: expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c04207d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/v/II"><ns0:num value="II">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04207e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vi"><ns0:num value="vi" class="bold">(vi)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Additional requirements for collection organizations</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">The requirements of this clause are met if the organization—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c04207f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vi/I"><ns0:num value="I">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:content> maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c042080-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vi/II"><ns0:num value="II">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:content> makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization, and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I77" class="indent5 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042081-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vii"><ns0:num value="vii" class="bold">(vii)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Special rule for States requiring tax uniformity</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3">In the case of a State—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c042082-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vii/I"><ns0:num value="I">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:content> that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c042083-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vii/II"><ns0:num value="II">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> that, as of <ns0:date date="1997-12-31">December 31, 1997</ns0:date>, imposed a tax on personal income with—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042084-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vii/II/aa"><ns0:num value="aa">(aa)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions); and</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
<ns0:item style="-uslm-lc:I580434" class="indent5" id="id9c042085-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/3/B/vii/II/bb"><ns0:num value="bb">(bb)</ns0:num><ns0:content> no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals;</ns0:content>
</ns0:item>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>

<ns0:continuation style="-uslm-lc:I66" class="indent3 firstIndent-1"> the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).</ns0:continuation>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042086-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/4"><ns0:num value="4" class="bold">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Limitation on use of funds for startup and administrative activities</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under this subsection.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042087-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/5"><ns0:num value="5" class="bold">(5)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Prohibition on use of funds for legal services or tuition assistance</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to provide legal services or to provide tuition assistance related to compulsory education requirements (not including tuition assistance for tutoring, camps, skills development, or other supplemental services or training).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042088-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9907/c/6"><ns0:num value="6" class="bold">(6)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Prohibition on supplanting funds</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to supplant non-Federal funds that would be available, in the absence of Federal funds, to offset a revenue loss of the State attributable to a charity tax credit.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c042089-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s675C">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 675C</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2731">112 Stat. 2731</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c04208a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="editorialNotes" id="id9c04208b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Editorial Notes</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="priorProvisions" id="id9c04208c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Prior Provisions</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">A prior section 9907, <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1981-08-13">Aug. 13, 1981</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/95/516">95 Stat. 516</ns0:ref>, related to payments to States, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. L. 105–285</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c04208d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908"><ns0:num value="9908">§ 9908.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Application and plan</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04208e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Designation of lead agency</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c04208f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Designation</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042090-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Duties</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The lead agency shall—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042091-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b);</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042092-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> in conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042093-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a/2/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> conduct reviews of eligible entities under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9914">section 9914 of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042094-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/a/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Legislative hearing</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c042095-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> State application and plan</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan covering a period of not less than 1 fiscal year and not more than 2 fiscal years. The plan shall be submitted not later than 30 days prior to the beginning of the first fiscal year covered by the plan, and shall contain such information as the Secretary shall require, including—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c042096-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c042097-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> to support activities that are designed to assist low-income families and individuals, including families and individuals receiving assistance under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s601">42 U.S.C. 601</ns0:ref> et seq.), homeless families and individuals, migrant or seasonal farmworkers, and elderly low-income individuals and families, and a description of how such activities will enable the families and individuals—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c042098-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to remove obstacles and solve problems that block the achievement of self-sufficiency (including self-sufficiency for families and individuals who are attempting to transition off a State program carried out under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act);</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c042099-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to secure and retain meaningful employment;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c04209a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/iii"><ns0:num value="iii">(iii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to attain an adequate education, with particular attention toward improving literacy skills of the low-income families in the communities involved, which may include carrying out family literacy initiatives;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c04209b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/iv"><ns0:num value="iv">(iv)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to make better use of available income;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c04209c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/v"><ns0:num value="v">(v)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to obtain and maintain adequate housing and a suitable living environment;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c04209d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/vi"><ns0:num value="vi">(vi)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to obtain emergency assistance through loans, grants, or other means to meet immediate and urgent family and individual needs; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c04209e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/vii"><ns0:num value="vii">(vii)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> to achieve greater participation in the affairs of the communities involved, including the development of public and private grassroots partnerships with local law enforcement agencies, local housing authorities, private foundations, and other public and private partners to—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c04209f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/vii/I"><ns0:num value="I">(I)</ns0:num><ns0:content> document best practices based on successful grassroots intervention in urban areas, to develop methodologies for widespread replication; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
<ns0:subclause style="-uslm-lc:I16" class="indent4" id="id9c0420a0-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/A/vii/II"><ns0:num value="II">(II)</ns0:num><ns0:content> strengthen and improve relationships with local law enforcement agencies, which may include participation in activities such as neighborhood or community policing efforts;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subclause>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420a1-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> to address the needs of youth in low-income communities through youth development programs that support the primary role of the family, give priority to the prevention of youth problems and crime, and promote increased community coordination and collaboration in meeting the needs of youth, and support development and expansion of innovative community-based youth development programs that have demonstrated success in preventing or reducing youth crime, such as—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c0420a2-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/B/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> programs for the establishment of violence-free zones that would involve youth development and intervention models (such as models involving youth mediation, youth mentoring, life skills training, job creation, and entrepreneurship programs); and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c0420a3-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/B/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> after-school child care programs; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420a4-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/1/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to make more effective use of, and to coordinate with, other programs related to the purposes of this chapter (including State welfare reform efforts);</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420a5-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a description of how the State intends to use discretionary funds made available from the remainder of the grant or allotment described in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b">section 9907(b) of this title</ns0:ref> in accordance with this chapter, including a description of how the State will support innovative community and neighborhood-based initiatives related to the purposes of this chapter;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420a6-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/3"><ns0:num value="3">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> information provided by eligible entities in the State, containing—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420a7-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/3/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a description of the service delivery system, for services provided or coordinated with funds made available through grants made under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a">section 9907(a) of this title</ns0:ref>, targeted to low-income individuals and families in communities within the State;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420a8-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/3/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a description of how linkages will be developed to fill identified gaps in the services, through the provision of information, referrals, case management, and followup consultations;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420a9-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/3/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a description of how funds made available through grants made under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9907/a">section 9907(a) of this title</ns0:ref> will be coordinated with other public and private resources; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420aa-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/3/D"><ns0:num value="D">(D)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a description of how the local entity will use the funds to support innovative community and neighborhood-based initiatives related to the purposes of this chapter, which may include fatherhood initiatives and other initiatives with the goal of strengthening families and encouraging effective parenting;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420ab-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/4"><ns0:num value="4">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that eligible entities in the State will provide, on an emergency basis, for the provision of such supplies and services, nutritious foods, and related services, as may be necessary to counteract conditions of starvation and malnutrition among low-income individuals;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420ac-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/5"><ns0:num value="5">(5)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State and the eligible entities in the State will coordinate, and establish linkages between, governmental and other social services programs to assure the effective delivery of such services to low-income individuals and to avoid duplication of such services, and a description of how the State and the eligible entities will coordinate the provision of employment and training activities, as defined in section 3 of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act [<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t29/s3102">29 U.S.C. 3102</ns0:ref>], in the State and in communities with entities providing activities through statewide and local workforce development systems under such Act;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420ad-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/6"><ns0:num value="6">(6)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State will ensure coordination between antipoverty programs in each community in the State, and ensure, where appropriate, that emergency energy crisis intervention programs under title XXVI [<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s8621">42 U.S.C. 8621</ns0:ref> et seq.] (relating to low-income home energy assistance) are conducted in such community;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420ae-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/7"><ns0:num value="7">(7)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State will permit and cooperate with Federal investigations undertaken in accordance with <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9916">section 9916 of this title</ns0:ref>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420af-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/8"><ns0:num value="8">(8)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that any eligible entity in the State that received funding in the previous fiscal year through a community services block grant made under this chapter will not have its funding terminated under this chapter, or reduced below the proportional share of funding the entity received in the previous fiscal year unless, after providing notice and an opportunity for a hearing on the record, the State determines that cause exists for such termination or such reduction, subject to review by the Secretary as provided in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9915/b">section 9915(b) of this title</ns0:ref>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420b0-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/9"><ns0:num value="9">(9)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State and eligible entities in the State will, to the maximum extent possible, coordinate programs with and form partnerships with other organizations serving low-income residents of the communities and members of the groups served by the State, including religious organizations, charitable groups, and community organizations;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420b1-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/10"><ns0:num value="10">(10)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State will require each eligible entity in the State to establish procedures under which a low-income individual, community organization, or religious organization, or representative of low-income individuals that considers its organization, or low-income individuals, to be inadequately represented on the board (or other mechanism) of the eligible entity to petition for adequate representation;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420b2-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/11"><ns0:num value="11">(11)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State will secure from each eligible entity in the State, as a condition to receipt of funding by the entity through a community services block grant made under this chapter for a program, a community action plan (which shall be submitted to the Secretary, at the request of the Secretary, with the State plan) that includes a community-needs assessment for the community served, which may be coordinated with community-needs assessments conducted for other programs;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420b3-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/12"><ns0:num value="12">(12)</ns0:num><ns0:content> an assurance that the State and all eligible entities in the State will, not later than fiscal year 2001, participate in the Results Oriented Management and Accountability System, another performance measure system for which the Secretary facilitated development pursuant to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b">section 9917(b) of this title</ns0:ref>, or an alternative system for measuring performance and results that meets the requirements of that section, and a description of outcome measures to be used to measure eligible entity performance in promoting self-sufficiency, family stability, and community revitalization; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420b4-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/13"><ns0:num value="13">(13)</ns0:num><ns0:content> information describing how the State will carry out the assurances described in this subsection.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420b5-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Funding termination or reductions</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420b6-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> a funding reduction, the term “cause” includes—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420b7-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> a statewide redistribution of funds provided through a community services block grant under this chapter to respond to—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c0420b8-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/1/A/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the results of the most recently available census or other appropriate data;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c0420b9-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/1/A/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the designation of a new eligible entity; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id9c0420ba-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/1/A/iii"><ns0:num value="iii">(iii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> severe economic dislocation; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420bb-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a">section 9915(a) of this title</ns0:ref>; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420bc-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/c/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a termination, the term “cause” includes the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a">section 9915(a) of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420bd-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/d"><ns0:num value="d" class="bold">(d)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Procedures and information</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary may prescribe procedures for the purpose of assessing the effectiveness of eligible entities in carrying out the purposes of this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420be-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/e"><ns0:num value="e" class="bold">(e)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Revisions and inspection</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420bf-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/e/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Revisions</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The chief executive officer of each State may revise any plan prepared under this section and shall submit the revised plan to the Secretary.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420c0-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/e/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Public inspection</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Each plan or revised plan prepared under this section shall be made available for public inspection within the State in such a manner as will facilitate review of, and comment on, the plan.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420c1-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9908/f"><ns0:num value="f" class="bold">(f)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Transition</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan in accordance with the provisions of this chapter (as in effect on the day before <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">October 27, 1998</ns0:date>), rather than the provisions of subsections (a) through (c) relating to applications and plans.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c0420c2-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s676">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 676</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. <ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c0420ca-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909"><ns0:num value="9909">§ 9909.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Designation and redesignation of eligible entities in unserved areas</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420cb-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Qualified organization in or near area</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420cc-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">If any geographic area of a State is not, or ceases to be, served by an eligible entity under this chapter, and if the chief executive officer of the State decides to serve such area, the chief executive officer may solicit applications from, and designate as an eligible entity—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420cd-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a private nonprofit organization (which may include an eligible entity) that is geographically located in the unserved area, that is capable of providing a broad range of services designed to eliminate poverty and foster self-sufficiency, and that meets the requirements of this chapter; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420ce-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a private nonprofit eligible entity that is geographically located in an area contiguous to or within reasonable proximity of the unserved area and that is already providing related services in the unserved area.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420cf-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Requirement</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">In order to serve as the eligible entity for the area, an entity described in paragraph (1)(B) shall agree to add additional members to the board of the entity to ensure adequate representation—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420d0-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> in each of the three required categories described in subparagraphs (A), (B), and (C) of <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2">section 9910(a)(2) of this title</ns0:ref>, by members that reside in the community comprised by the unserved area; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420d1-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/a/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> in the category described in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2/B">section 9910(a)(2)(B) of this title</ns0:ref>, by members that reside in the neighborhood to be served.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420d2-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Special consideration</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">In designating an eligible entity under subsection (a), the chief executive officer shall grant the designation to an organization of demonstrated effectiveness in meeting the goals and purposes of this chapter and may give priority, in granting the designation, to eligible entities that are providing related services in the unserved area, consistent with the needs identified by a community-needs assessment.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420d3-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9909/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> No qualified organization in or near area</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">If no private, nonprofit organization is identified or determined to be qualified under subsection (a) to serve the unserved area as an eligible entity the chief executive officer may designate an appropriate political subdivision of the State to serve as an eligible entity for the area. In order to serve as the eligible entity for that area, the political subdivision shall have a board or other mechanism as required in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b">section 9910(b) of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c0420d4-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s676A">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 676A</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2739">112 Stat. 2739</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>

<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="priorProvisions" id="id9c0420d7-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Prior Provisions</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">A prior section 9909, <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s680">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 680</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1981-08-13">Aug. 13, 1981</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/95/517">95 Stat. 517</ns0:ref>; <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/99/425/tIV/s405/c/2">Pub. L. 103–171, § 7(c)(3)</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1993-12-02">Dec. 2, 1993</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/107/1994">107 Stat. 1994</ns0:ref>, related to limitation on use of grants for construction and waiver of such limitation, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. <ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">A prior <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/s676A">section 676A of Pub. L. 97–35</ns0:ref> was classified to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9905a">section 9905a of this title</ns0:ref>, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. L. 105–285</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>

<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c0420d8-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910"><ns0:num value="9910">§ 9910.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Tripartite boards</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420d9-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Private nonprofit entities</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420da-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Board</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9902/1">section 9902(1) of this title</ns0:ref>, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board described in paragraph (2) that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420db-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Selection and composition of board</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The members of the board referred to in paragraph (1) shall be selected by the entity and the board shall be composed so as to assure that—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420dc-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> ⅓ of the members of the board are elected public officials, holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives, except that if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting such ⅓ requirement;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420dd-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420de-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2/B/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420df-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2/B/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> each representative of low-income individuals and families selected to represent a specific neighborhood within a community under clause (i) resides in the neighborhood represented by the member; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420e0-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/a/2/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c0420e1-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Public organizations</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9902/1">section 9902(1) of this title</ns0:ref>, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420e2-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> a tripartite board, which shall have members selected by the organization and shall be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420e3-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420e4-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> reside in the neighborhood served; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c0420e5-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b/1/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c0420e6-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9910/b/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
